name: Salmon noodle soup
assumptions: Yield of 4 inferred from explicit instruction to ladle into 4 bowls
Total time is sum of sequential cooking steps (8 min + 2 min + 3 min) plus negligible time to bring stock to boil
Gluten-free is null because soy sauce is typically brewed with wheat and rice noodles are sometimes processed with wheat starch; no certification mentioned
Shellfish is null because Thai red curry paste sometimes contains shrimp paste but is not explicitly listed as an ingredient
Peanuts is null because some Thai curry pastes contain trace peanuts but not declared here
Wheat is null because soy sauce usually contains wheat but some brands are wheat-free; rice noodles are usually but not always wheat-free
Sesame is null because some commercial curry pastes or soy sauces may contain trace sesame
instructions:
step 1
Pour the stock into a large pan, bring to the boil, then stir in the curry paste. Add the noodles and cook for 8 mins. Tip in the mushrooms and corn and cook for 2 mins more.

step 2
Add the salmon to the pan and cook for 3 mins or until cooked through. Remove from the heat and stir in the lime juice, soy sauce and a pinch of sugar. Ladle into 4 bowls and sprinkle over the coriander just before you serve.

ingredients.name: Chicken Stock
ingredients.assumptions: Standard chicken stock values for 1 L; negligible calories from fat and carbs in clear stock.

ingredients.name: Thai Red Curry Paste
ingredients.assumptions: Typical red Thai curry paste density ~5 g per tsp; values reflect average commercial paste.

ingredients.name: Rice Noodles
ingredients.assumptions: Dry rice noodles as added before boiling; standard uncooked values.

ingredients.name: Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients.assumptions: Fresh shiitake mushrooms; typical raw edible portion.

ingredients.name: Sweetcorn
ingredients.assumptions: Canned or frozen sweetcorn kernels, drained weight; standard values.

ingredients.name: Salmon
ingredients.assumptions: 2 typical salmon fillets ~150 g each raw edible weight; Atlantic farmed salmon averages.

ingredients.name: Lime
ingredients.assumptions: Juice of 2 limes ≈ 60 ml / 60 g total; values for lime juice.

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: Standard soy sauce, 1 tbsp ≈ 15 g; typical fermented values.

ingredients.name: Brown Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: Pinch of brown sugar assumed as 2 g for subtle sweetness; nearly pure sucrose.

ingredients.name: Coriander
ingredients.assumptions: A bunch of fresh coriander assumed as 25 g usable leaves and stems; typical herb values.
